src: Ancestry (ancestry.com.au, requester logged in) — Janko Spudic b.1891 ±5 (13 results) and Polovich b.1860 ±20 (19,459 results, first page only)
note: Janko: 13 hits - an Ancestry tree 'Spudic Family Tree' listing Janko / John Spudich b.1891 Yugoslavia (parents hidden), Ellis Island/Hamburg passenger lists, 1930/1940 censuses (likely other John Spudics), Find a Grave index; most field values were masked on the results page and no record was opened. Polovich: first page only; includes 'Illinois, U.S., Roman Catholic Diocese of Springfield Sacramental Records, 1853-1981' (hit: Nicholas Polovich). That collection covers Macoupin County parishes (Mt Olive) and is the best lead for Janko's c.1920-22 marriage and Anna's maiden name; not yet searched for Spudic. Earlier bot-check block was cleared by the requester logging in.

src: Ancestry — Illinois, U.S., Roman Catholic Diocese of Springfield Sacramental Records, 1853-1981 (collection 61682): name Spudic (similar spellings), then marriages 1921 ±4; opened Janko/John Spudich b.1891 tree entry
note: 314 hits for Spudic and similar spellings (Latin forms: Joannis, Stephani, Thomae, Nicholai, Michaelis Spudic; baptisms of children). Results page masks dates and places; opening a record (e.g. 427663 'Joannem Spadich', marriage) or the 'Spudic Family Tree' person page (tree 188790393, person 312451317497) goes to Ancestry's 'Join' paywall, so no detail was read. Marriage filter 1917-1925 returned 5 index hits: Joannem Spadich, Helen, Bertha, George and Dorothy Spudich. These are only names; none is confirmed as Janko or Anna. Needs a paid Ancestry subscription, or a library edition (Ancestry Library at a public library often includes it), to read. The Diocese of Springfield archives (and Mt Olive parish) hold the originals.

src: FamilySearch Family Tree (requester signed in) — tree search Vid Spudić b.1826-30 Leskovac; person pages LZJV-W2L (Vid Spudić b.15 Nov 1846) and LZJV-4SD (Dorotea Polović b.4 Jun 1846)
note: Tree entries, 0 sources attached, 0 children listed. Vid Spudić b.15 Nov 1846 Leskovac Barilovićki, son of Ivan Spudić (b.1801) and Ana Maglić (1806-1852, m. abt 1829), 10 children. He m. 27 Nov 1867 Leskovac Dorotea Polović, b.4 Jun 1846 Novaki, daughter of Josip Polović (b.1810) and Barbara Jurčević (b.1815, m. 26 Nov 1832 Leskovac), siblings Juraj 1836, Jelena 1838, Josip 1841-43, Nikola 1844-51. NAMES AND PLACE MATCH Janko's parents (Vid + Dora Polović, Leskovac) but nothing yet ties this couple to Janko b.1891: a Vid of 44 and a Dora of 45 is possible but late. Separately: Vid b.8 Jan 1828 (LZXW-4QY, parents Johannes Janko Spudić & Ana Pavletić, m. 2 Mar 1851 Jelena Aršulić) is the line in Karen's tree.

src: FamilySearch — 1913 Ellis Island manifest image 643 (President Lincoln, Hamburg, 9 Apr 1913), via record 1:1:JNPZ-7PV
note: Opened and zoomed. The sheet is right; the line headed 'Spudic' (line 25, age 24) was located, but the relative and destination columns could not be reliably aligned to that line at the viewer's resolution; the legible relative entries nearby belong to other passengers. A destination of 'Mt. Olive' appears on a nearby line only. Needs a reader at full size.

src: FamilySearch — Croatia, Church Books, Leskovac-Barilovićki births 1832-1857: image 78 (right page, June 1846) and image 81 (left page, Nov 1846), read at zoom
note: Births are tabular Latin, one image = a two-page spread of ~6 entries a page; 1846 runs through images 77-81 (image 78 = June 1846, image 80 = Sept-Nov, image 81 = Nov-Dec). FOUND: (1) image 78, right page, entry no. 21: 1846, 4 June, Leskovac, 'Dorothea, filia legitima Catholica'; father Josephus Polovich ex Novaki, mother Barbara nata Jurcevich (spelling read, partly uncertain), priest Ladislaus Jagodich. Matches the Family Tree's Dorotea Polović b.4 Jun 1846, parents Josip Polović and Barbara Jurčević. (2) image 81, left page: 1846, mid-November (day reads 15 or 16), 'Vitus, filius legitimus Catholicus'; father Joannes [middle word unclear] Spudich ex Leskovac N° 16 (house number read as 16), mother Anna nata Maglich; godparents Thomas ... ex Szello. Matches the Family Tree's Vid Spudić b.15 Nov 1846, parents Ivan Spudić and Ana Maglić. Same page has a Michael Spudich of Leskovac N° 16 and wife Catharina (a child 'Helena').

src: FamilySearch — Leskovac-Barilovićki marriages 1832-1857, book II: images 462-467 (cover; 1832, 1833, 1834, 1835)
note: CORRECTION 17 Oct 2026 (later): the Family Tree's marriage of Josip Polović and Barbara Jurčević on 26 Nov 1832 IS in the register: image 465, LEFT page, entry dated 'Die 26 9bris 1832': Josephus Pollovich, confirmed, bachelor, with Barbara Iurkovich/Jurcevich (reading partly uncertain), virgin, ex Novaki, ages read 22 and 17. My earlier note (no Nov 1832 entry; last 1832 entry 26 Sept) was wrong: image 464's right page holds only the first six entries (17 Mar to 26 Sept) and the 1832 entries continue on image 465's left page. Book II structure: 462 cover, 464 first page (left side blank), 465 left = rest of 1832 and early 1833 (attestation 9 Oct 1833 at its foot), 465 right = Oct-Nov 1833 (25 Nov 1833 wedding day), 466 = Nov 1834 (25-26 Nov) then 1835, 467 = 25 Nov 1835. Month abbreviations: 7bris=September, 9bris=November, 8bris=October. Spudich/Polovich entries as read (some handwriting uncertain): 1833 Feb Michael Suran? widower m. Barbara, widow of Josephus Spudich (decurio); 25 Nov 1833 Georgius Spudich m. Susana Pergovich, Lucas Spudich m. Hellena Machich, Joannes Shinnunich m. Margaritha Spudich; Nov 1834 Thomas Spudich m. Magdalena Subchich, and Joannes Ev. Polovich widower m. widow Margaritha; early 1835 Petrus Pollovich widower m. widow Dorothea Dobrinich; 25 Nov 1835 Marcus Chuhilovich widower m. Catharina, widow of Petrus Spudich, and Mathias Pollovich (son of the late Matthias) m. Magdalena, daughter of a late Josephus (surname read as Spudich?, uncertain). No Vid Spudić or Ivan Spudić marriage seen in 1832-35 (Ivan m. about 1829, before the book).
